ablation: L1 top-down path (lesion_l1) — the same lesion as K3/K3B/K3C. Intact and lesioned arms share identical transition streams and identical init seeds within each seed (paired).
background: EXP-AB-K3B (2026-10-07, 3 seeds) found the hierarchy 'earns its keep' on changing_rule + delayed_reward: arm-A |rerr| gap +0.0602 (~19x K3's +0.0032). EXP-AB-5SEED (5 fresh seeds) REPRODUCED the verdict at 4/5 BUT the headline channel reversed: arm-A |rerr| gap -0.0319 seed-mean (negative 3/5 — the +0.0602 was seed-fragile); the signal actually rides |e0| (+0.0079 seed-mean, 4/5 positive) at ~2.5x K3's scale, not 19x. Recorded as NR-B-009 (claim weakened). The hierarchy's surviving claim is now: L1 context tables reduce the L0 state-prediction error |e0| on structured tasks. This experiment characterizes that surviving channel: per-env magnitude with CIs, and the mechanism question — memorization vs genuine context-dependent dynamics.
baseline: arch_b lesion_l1=True (L0-only), identical transition streams and identical agent init seeds within each seed.

conditions.changing_rule: v1.0.0 — 45 episodes x 40 steps (PHASE_LEN=5, phases 0-8). ArchB closed-loop reference (affect='none'), ref seed base 76210+si. Train = transitions 0-1499 (episodes 0-37, phases 0-7). Held-out STABLE = transitions 1520-1599 (episodes 38-39, phase 7 — same rule as training end, unseen). Held-out POST-FLIP = transitions 1600-1799 (episodes 40-44, phase 8 — flipped rule). Rule-contingent channel: last_reward; rule-invariant: cue, last_action.
conditions.compositional_rule: v1.0.0 — 45 episodes x 40 steps (PHASE_LEN=5, phases 0-8). ArchB closed-loop reference (affect='none'), ref seed base 76220+si. Train = transitions 0-1519 (episodes 0-37, phases 0-7). Held-out STABLE = transitions 1520-1599 (episodes 38-39, phase 7). Held-out POST-FLIP = transitions 1600-1799 (episodes 40-44, phase 8). (Train is 80 transitions shorter than K3C's 1600 — preregistered characterization split; limitation noted.) Rule-contingent channel: last_reward; rule-invariant: cue_a, cue_b, last_action.
conditions.delayed_multistep: v1.0.0 — 30 episodes. Scripted reference policy (collect_scripted_multistep verbatim). Train = episodes 0-19; held-out = episodes 20-29 (K3C-task-1-faithful). No flip structure — per-env gap + per-channel decomposition only.
conditions.delayed_reward: v1.0.0 — 60 episodes. ArchB closed-loop reference (affect='none'), ref seed base 76230+si. Train = first 600 transitions; held-out = last 120 (K3B-arm-B-faithful). No flip structure — per-env gap + per-channel decomposition only.
conditions.instrument: experiments_phase4._train_eval_ab training path verbatim (ArchB.learn_transition open-loop); eval = predict_next path (the exact computation eval_transition performs) with per-trial per-channel errors recorded. New driver: prototypes/architecture-b/experiments_k3d.py (additive).

consciousness_note: CONSCIOUSNESS: UNRESOLVED. Prediction-error gaps are mechanisms, not subjects. No claim about experience is made or implied by any outcome.
decision_rule: CHARACTERIZATION — no kill gate (descriptive success criteria, preregistered): S1 per-env D_e0 seed-mean + 95% CI + sign counts on the 4 fresh seeds is recorded. S2 the flip-env decomposition (stable vs post-flip D_e0; per-channel D_c on stable vs post-flip) is recorded. S3 the mechanism is classified by the preregistered signatures below and reported as INTERPRETATION, not a pass/fail gate. Interpretation signatures: MEMORIZATION = D_e0(post-flip) <= 0 while D_e0(stable) > 0 on the flip envs, with the gap concentrated in the rule-contingent channel (last_reward) whose sign flips across the flip. DYNAMICS = D_e0(post-flip) > 0 with the gap spread across rule-invariant channels (the flip does not kill the advantage). MIXED/OTHER = anything else — reported descriptively, no forced verdict. If the null holds (D_e0 <= 0 seed-mean on all 4 envs), the |e0| channel is recorded as KILLED in research/negative_results.md and the hierarchy row is demoted accordingly.
donor_provenance: No donor code. ArchB and the four envs are Estate-native (flesh-pits prototypes/experiments).

gates_void.G0a: held-out segment transition count == 0 -> VOID that segment (fail-closed; cannot happen by construction).
gates_void.G0b: determinism spot-check: first seed, intact arm, recompute held-out |e0| through the identical helper; must match the recorded values to 1e-12, else VOID the run.

hypothesis: DESCRIPTIVE (characterization, not a kill test): the intact-vs-L1-lesioned |e0| gap D_e0 = mean|e0|_lesioned - mean|e0|_intact is characterized per env (changing_rule, delayed_reward, delayed_multistep, compositional_rule) with 95% CIs on 4 fresh seeds. MECHANISM: on the two flip envs (changing_rule, compositional_rule), D_e0 is decomposed into (a) stable-phase held-out trials (same rule as the end of training — the L1 D[ctx] tables' memorized regime) vs (b) post-flip held-out trials (flipped rule — the tables' memorized regime is stale). If the |e0| advantage is memorization of the old phase's per-context contingency means, the advantage vanishes or reverses post-flip (the K3C signature: R tables memorize the old phase and predict it confidently after the flip). If it is genuine context-dependent dynamics, the advantage survives the flip, concentrated in rule-invariant channels.
metric: Per env, per seed, per held-out segment: D_e0 = mean|e0|_lesioned - mean|e0|_intact, where |e0| is the L2 norm of the per-channel prediction error from the eval_transition prediction path (ctx = context_key(o), xhat = model.predict_next(o, a, ctx)), K3B-faithful. Per-channel gap D_c = mean_c|err|_lesioned - mean_c|err|_intact for each obs channel c. Seed-mean with 95% t-CI (df=3, t=3.1824) and per-seed values recorded. Secondary diagnostics: n_contexts (L1 contexts created) per seed, intact arm.
null: The |e0| advantage is gone everywhere: D_e0 <= 0 seed-mean on all 4 envs (the lesion ties or helps) — the surviving channel is dead too, and the hierarchy's longer-horizon contribution is fully extinguished.
pilot_notes: No pilot informed thresholds (characterization; no kill gate). All splits are first-principles from the envs' documented phase structure (PHASE_LEN=5; K3B/K3C held-out conventions). Fresh seeds {76101..76104} checked against the registry, preregistrations, receipts, and prototype sources before sealing — zero overlap (76001..76004 belong to EXP-SW-02-B).
procedure: Open-loop transition training via learn_transition (no retrieval correction, no affect — isolates the weight/precision machinery, as in K3/K3B/K3C). Reference streams: changing_rule / compositional_rule / delayed_reward via ArchB closed-loop reference (affect='none'), K3B-arm-A/K3C-task-2-faithful; delayed_multistep via the deterministic scripted policy (experiments_k3c.collect_scripted_multistep verbatim — ArchB/random references stall per K3C pilot). Held-out evaluation is pure prediction (no learning): per-trial per-channel |err| via the model's predict_next path (exactly the computation eval_transition performs; per-channel recorded additionally). Terminal-tick flag not needed (|e0| channel only).
task: Characterize the K3B |e0|-channel — the surviving hierarchy signal after NR-B-009 weakened the reward channel.
title: EXP-AB-K3D preregistration — K3B |e0|-channel characterization (mechanism: memorization vs dynamics)
